title: Run concurrent checks with one signed-in identity
when: Several workers need the same browser identity on one machine
need: Each check copies the authoritative sign-in state into a private browser. Interactive steps carry check_id and keep_open until the last step, or close through qa browser stop. Cases close automatically; abandoned copies are swept after their owner exits. Authorize again when the authoritative sign-in expires, then start a new check. Inspect only that check with qa browser status --check-id ID; default readiness never probes the authoritative profile's daemon.
